name: simple two-edge path
code:
edges = [(0, 1, 1), (1, 2, 2)]
result = dijkstra(3, edges, 0)
assert result == [0, 1, 3]

name: unreachable vertex
code:
edges = [(0, 1, 5)]
result = dijkstra(3, edges, 0)
assert result[0] == 0
assert result[1] == 5
assert result[2] == float('inf')

name: source to itself is zero
code:
edges = [(0, 1, 1), (1, 2, 2)]
result = dijkstra(3, edges, 1)
assert result[1] == 0

name: multiple paths — shortest wins
code:
edges = [(0, 1, 10), (0, 2, 1), (2, 3, 1), (1, 3, 5)]
result = dijkstra(4, edges, 0)
assert result == [0, 10, 1, 3]

name: star graph from source
code:
edges = [(0, 1, 2), (0, 2, 3), (0, 3, 4)]
result = dijkstra(4, edges, 0)
assert result == [0, 2, 3, 4]

name: self-loop ignored correctly
code:
edges = [(0, 0, 1), (0, 1, 2)]
result = dijkstra(2, edges, 0)
assert result == [0, 2]

name: parallel edges — shorter wins
code:
edges = [(0, 1, 5), (0, 1, 3)]
result = dijkstra(2, edges, 0)
assert result == [0, 3]

name: chain with zero-weight edge
code:
edges = [(0, 1, 0), (1, 2, 0), (2, 3, 1)]
result = dijkstra(4, edges, 0)
assert result == [0, 0, 0, 1]

name: triangular path comparison
code:
edges = [(0, 1, 4), (0, 2, 1), (2, 1, 2), (1, 3, 1)]
result = dijkstra(4, edges, 0)
assert result == [0, 3, 1, 4]
